class.name: SpineMesh2D
class.brief_description: Internal canvas mesh node created by [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] for each skeleton slot.
class.description: [code]SpineMesh2D[/code] is an internal rendering node. [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] creates one child per skeleton slot. Each child holds deformed vertices, UVs, vertex colors, and indices for its slot. The parent updates this data every frame and draws through [code]RenderingServer[/code]. On Godot 4 the parent uploads a mesh RID and calls [code]canvas_item_add_mesh()[/code] with the slot atlas texture. Slot draw order follows skeleton slot order. [code]SpineSlotNode2D[/code] inserts extra [code]Node2D[/code] content at a named slot. This class exposes no script API. [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] owns rendering. [code]SpineSlotNode2D[/code] adds draw-order content at a slot.
